Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, shaggy layered golden blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy emerald-green PVC, made of two small triangle cups each edged with a thin polished chrome ring and held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by one rigid flat polished chrome bar about one finger wide running straight down the center of her stomach from between the cups to the front of the bottom, with three round chrome rivets set along it, her waist sides, her flanks, her stomach and the skin around the bar bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.

Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a white marble stand in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic Victorian glass cloche dome with a brass knob rests on the stand like a museum specimen display, giant dried flowers, giant pressed ferns and gigantic white pillar candles standing around it, the curved glass dome reflecting a bright window, a softly blurred conservatory with plants far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall standing under the glass dome with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright soft window light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous glass dome, dried flowers and candles around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
